About

Clinical depth.
Academic rigour.

A dual-trained clinician with 9+ years of experience across India, Saudi Arabia, and the UAE, I bring specialist-level expertise in Oral Medicine and Maxillofacial Radiology to every patient interaction.

From interpreting complex CBCT scans and managing pre-malignant disorders to delivering Invisalign transformations and aesthetic restorations, my practice sits at the intersection of diagnostic precision and patient-centred care.

Beyond the clinic, I am an award-winning researcher, a published author across five peer-reviewed works, and an active healthcare content creator dedicated to bridging clinical dentistry with patient education.
